messages:
oncall-bot: [ALERT] sev2: repeated GPU OOMs during prefill on cluster fastflow-prod. Multiple inference-api containers restarting over the last 3m, elevated error rate and 5xx responses. Pager: oncall-eng.

oncall-bot: Incident channel opened. Runbook: <https://redwood.internal/runbooks/prefill-oom>|prefill-oom runbook.

ashley: ack. I'm oncall for the next 2hrs, starting triage. tagging triage leads @sam @kevin.

sam: seeing repeated CUDA failures in runtime logs + occasional std::bad_alloc. snippet: 
```
E 03:21:12 runtime.cpp:453 CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY: failed to allocate 1.2G
terminate called after throwing an instance of 'std::bad_alloc'
# nvml memory snapshot: gpu-node-17: used 39.8G / 40.0G
```

sam: spikes correlate with very large prefill windows from a few clients — token counts reported up to ~700k per prefill. nodes impacted: gpu-node-17, gpu-node-21.

kevin: temporary mitigation plan: 1) cap prefill length at gateway 2) enable aggressive kvcache eviction 3) route heavy traffic to smaller model variant. Doing step 1 now.

kevin: applying env var to gateway: MAX_PREFILL_TOKENS=65536 and restarting.
```
kubectl -n prod set env deploy/gateway MAX_PREFILL_TOKENS=65536
kubectl -n prod rollout restart deploy/gateway
```

devon: pushed runtime patch to enable aggressive kvcache eviction on long sessions for pool fastflow-prod. annotation set: runtime.kvcache.eviction=aggressive. rolling to 10% first.

sam: also adding a throttling rule to apirouter to 429 requests >64k tokens. Patch applied.

maria: customer impact check — initial sig: three customers with increased errors and latency: acme-marketing, beta-search, partner-analytics. Support notified and I'm drafting an outbound.

ryan: shifting a portion of traffic to rdl-7b-quant to reduce peak GPU mem usage while nodes stabilize. Applying routing tweak (30%):
```
redwood route set --from inference-prod --to rdl-7b-quant --weight 0.3
```

ops-bot: Nodes cordoned: gpu-node-17, gpu-node-21 for deeper forensics.

ashley: observed container restarts fall from ~12/min to ~1/min after gateway cap + kvcache eviction + routing. Still monitoring 10m window.

sam: collecting heap + NVML traces, uploading to s3: s3://redwood-ops/incident-3660004321/trace.tar.gz

kevin: pushed hotfix to runtime to avoid full allocation path for very large prefills (>512k tokens). Will canary to 20% then roll.

ashley: canary to 20% applied on canary pool. metrics look stable so far.

maria: customer note sent to affected accounts. Support ticket ids: S-8954, S-8955, S-8956.

ashley: mitigation effective, incident status: mitigated. Owners: runtime-team (kevin) for code fix, gateway-team (kevin) for limits, ops (devon) for node investigation, support (maria) for customer comms.

maria: prepping closure message + postmortem template, will schedule incident review.

oncall-bot: Incident closed by ashley at 3660005250.

[summary emoji reactions and short thumbs-up from responders]
